info.description: For use by AWS Ground Station Agent and shouldn't be called directly.  Update the status of the agent.
info.title: AWS Ground Station

requests.description: Cancels a contact with a specified contact ID.
requests.name: DELETE /contact/{contactId}
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes an existing contact.
requests.name: GET /contact/{contactId}
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Creates a Config with the specified configData parameters.

Only one type of configData can be specified.
requests.name: POST /config
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of Config objects.
requests.name: GET /config
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Creates a DataflowEndpoint group containing the specified list of DataflowEndpoint objects.

The name field in each endpoint is used in your mission profile DataflowEndpointConfig to specify which endpoints to use during a contact.

When a contact uses multiple DataflowEndpointConfig objects, each Config must match a DataflowEndpoint in the same group.
requests.name: POST /dataflowEndpointGroup
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of DataflowEndpoint groups.
requests.name: GET /dataflowEndpointGroup
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: POST /ephemeris

requests.description:
Creates a mission profile.

dataflowEdges is a list of lists of strings. Each lower level list of strings has two elements: a from ARN and a to ARN.
requests.name: POST /missionprofile
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_GROUND_STATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
